conventions: Two-token proper names that MACULA segments and the ASV also writes in two tokens — מַלְכִּי שׁוּעַ → Malchi shua (8.33), מְרִיב בַּעַל → Merib baal (8.34) — are matched surface to surface, one unit per token, rather than fused as one two-token unit; where the name is a verbless-clause predicate the construction's copula joins the first element (was Merib). 1CH.9.39-40 repeats both names and should follow this.

וְ + noun + suffix recast by the ASV as a relative clause (whose wife's name was Maacah 8.29, whose names are these 8.38): the suffix takes whose (rule 18), the waw is unrepresented because no connective is written for it, and the copula joins the Hebrew predicate (was Maacah on the name; names are on שְׁמוֹת) whatever order the ASV writes. 1CH.9.35 repeats the first clause.
report: Read all 26 candidate groups against the verses. None is a split: every two-way bucket is the ASV writing or omitting a copula, a subject pronoun or a connective, and the source licenses each difference.

וְ before a noun/demonstrative: 8.29 and 8.38 leave the waw unrepresented because the ASV recasts וְשֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ / וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹתָם as a relative clause whose only connective, whose, realizes the suffix (rule 18); 8.6, 8.30 and 8.34 have a written And/and. Consistent.
לְ: 8.3 unrepresented beside a written הָיָה that takes had, 8.38 takes had in a verbless clause — exactly rule 43's two cases.

Copula placement is uniform: it joins the Hebrew predicate in every verbless clause (are the sons 8.6, names are 8.38, was Merib 8.34, was son 8.37, was Maacah 8.29), whichever order the ASV writes; names without a written copula take only the name.

Two-token names מַלְכִּי שׁוּעַ (8.33) and מְרִיב בַּעַל (8.34) are matched token to token against Malchi shua / Merib baal, the first element taking the copula where one is written; recorded as a convention since 1CH.9 repeats the same names.
BSB disagreements (8.3 לְ, 8.6 הֵם, 8.13 הָ, 8.30 הַ, 8.29 and 8.38 וְ) are all documented convention differences (rules 43, 20, 29, 41/47, 18); none is an error.
Jeiel in 8.29 is added: italic in the ASV, supplied from 9:35, no token in WLC and no variant unit recorded (rules 7, 53). children in 8.8 is a supplied object noun (rule 44). Both stand.
Nothing here generalises beyond the contract; no promotions or amendments.
